mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses risk-free rates, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market participants anticipate accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings pressure.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises > 0.3pp, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as revenue expectations decline.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or interaction effect Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as growth expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, INDPRO declines do not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) reflects strong consumer confidence and economic momentum, consistently driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as growth expectations strengthen.
failure_condition: HOUST increases are followed by negative 5-day SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate severe labor market deterioration, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to recession risk pricing.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or interaction effect Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery regimes, a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing sector strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as economic momentum accelerates.
failure_condition: In post-recession recovery, INDPRO increases do not produce positive 5-day SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year window is below 0.02.
